description: ContextStore uses a single RLock at store instance level. Different conversations are serialized through the same lock.

test_scenario.description: conversation A and conversation B in parallel
test_scenario.method: Concurrent POST requests to /v1/chat/completions with different X-Local2API-Conversation-ID headers
test_scenario.expected: no cross contamination, no unnecessary global serialization if per-conversation locks, but currently globally serialized
test_scenario.result: PARTIAL - no cross contamination (PASS), but unnecessary global serialization (suboptimal)
test_scenario.global_serialization: YES - all conversations share same RLock

conclusion: Different conversations are correctly isolated (no cross-contamination) but are unnecessarily serialized through a single global RLock. Per-conversation lock map would improve concurrency but not required for correctness.
